summary: Archuleta County tower on the mesa listed as removed; a Forest Lookouts page names the Southern Ute Indian Agency. No build date, design or history found.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source describes what remains

evidence.supports: mesa in the southern San Juan Mountains, southwestern Colorado
evidence.quote: The mesa is located in the southern portions of the San Juan Mountain Range, located in southwestern Colorado

evidence.supports: tower on Archuleta Mesa, Archuleta County, coordinates, removed

notes_for_editor: Only three pages were usable and none gives a build date, design, staffing or fire history. The Southern Ute Indian Agency link comes from one line on the Forest Lookouts page and no other source confirms it, so verify it before publishing; the brief had no agency. The FFLA list shows the tower as removed with no register number. Wikipedia is used only for the location; its 1996 wildfire on the mesa is unrelated and left out. A YouTube search snippet claims a 1936 build, but the video was not read, so that date is unverified and not used. Two web searches found nothing else.
